Notify: split pending · #28413 · do not claim the close half

The epic's schedule review found a release-safety gap in this card as filed: Wanted 4 (refuse package-less PUT / DELETE on a shipped name, rollback, source save and reset included) and Wanted 5 (Studio stops offering the overlay link) would land before Studio can customize views, dashboards and reports (N-17) or edit email templates and translations (N-25). A release cut in that window leaves administrators nowhere to customize those items, and on a deployment that has not run the `os migrate` ceremony, the existing overlay rows are served but can no longer be edited, reset or deleted.

The epic PM is splitting the card, executing the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」 with the review folded in. This card is being rewritten to the migration ceremony only (Wanted 1–3), and the close half (Wanted 4–5) moves to a new child that waits on N-17 and N-25. The rewrite lands shortly. ⛔ Until it does, no seat claims Wanted 4–5 from this body.
